class.name: RuntimeVirtualTextureVolume
class.description: Defines the box covered by a [RuntimeVirtualTexture]. The node position and rotation together with [member size] define the covered box: the X and Z axes span the texture, the Y axis is the rendered height range, and the texture is rendered looking down the node's negative Y axis. The node scale is ignored.

members.member: Size of the covered box in meters. The node scale is ignored.
The texture rendered inside this volume.
